settings.heading: Every order helps a stray
settings.text: A portion of every sale is donated to rescues and shelters that give stray dogs a second chance.

settings.heading: Good dogs deserve good homes
settings.text: We started Stray Dog because we kept meeting strays on the water — at marinas, boat ramps, and beaches — and wanted to do something about it.
settings.text2: Every product funds food, vet care, and adoptions through our rescue partners.

settings.heading: Donate
settings.text: A cut of every order goes to rescue partners.

settings.heading: Rescue
settings.text: Funds help shelters cover food, meds, and transport.

settings.heading: Adopt
settings.text: We share adoptable dogs with the pack on our channels.
